items.stem: For estimating the AR(2) process yt = Φ₁·yt−1 + Φ₂·yt−2 + εt the Yule–Walker equations are used. If the sample autocorrelations are r₁ = 0.8 and r₂ = 0.5, then the estimate of Φ₂ is:
items.explanation: Yule–Walker: r₁ = φ₁ + φ₂r₁ and r₂ = φ₁r₁ + φ₂, so φ₂ = (r₂ − r₁²)/(1 − r₁²) = (0.5 − 0.64)/(1 − 0.64) = −0.14/0.36 = −7/18. Official answer A. Response sheet Q69; you marked B — wrong.
